_comment: Golden A/B study: 20um soldermask over the feed only (not the enclosed cavity top -- see palace_dualmode_driven.py soldermask_um docstring), same design/launch as the sma_taoglas golden entry. Compare against that entry for the bare-copper baseline.

soldermask.note: typical LPI (liquid photoimageable) soldermask values; not measured for a specific vendor product

launch.description: Same as the bare-copper golden entry -- pad-only ground stitching, unchanged.

comparison_vs_bare_copper.conclusion: Substantial detuning from the feed coating alone: S11w degrades 7.7dB, bandwidth widens 28%, fc shifts +15MHz. Confirms CLAUDE.md sec 4s qualitative prediction (mask matters at the feed, not the cavity) and quantifies it -- large enough to matter for fabrication, not negligible.
